scope: Authored provenance and assay index; primary findings are paraphrases, not self-validating quotations. Complete raw records and read ledgers are retained in the temporary review packet.

primary_sources.access_scope: The complete authentic abstract explicitly names purified human CIB2 and its metal and integrin-tail binding. Original full text was not recovered after bounded publisher attempts; no numerical affinities or full-Methods inspection are claimed.
primary_sources.finding: Purified human CIB2 binds Ca and Mg and interacts with alphaIIb and alpha7B cytoplasmic fragments.

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected full Methods, Results and interaction/localization passages read. Human CIB2 cellular calcium assays, mouse tissue/explant localization and fly photoreceptor perturbations are kept distinct; tags and co-IP do not resolve obligate dimer stoichiometry.
primary_sources.finding: CIB2 binds cellular partners, attenuates ATP-evoked calcium responses and localizes in sensory structures; retinal perturbation evidence includes a separate fly model.

primary_sources.access_scope: Actual full Results and assay scope read: tagged wild-type/R66W/F91S CIB2 in mouse sensory explants and COS7 ATP-response experiments. The measured wild-type direction is calcium-response attenuation.
primary_sources.finding: R66W and F91S retain the measured localization and cellular buffering properties despite their disease association.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Full human eye-cDNA construct Methods, mouse explant localization, tagged co-IP and calcium-response passages read. The calcium Methods/Results say HEK293 whereas Figure7 legend says COS7; this internal cell-line inconsistency is retained as a scope limitation.
primary_sources.finding: Human CIB2 R186W retains measured localization and whirlin association but impairs the wild-type calcium-response attenuation in the tested cellular assay.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Exact main cache is incomplete and preserved. The independent genuine normal full variant was read for AP-MS Methods; one exact HEK293T PARD3B–CIB2 IntAct record identifies the target association. This is complex-level evidence, not purified direct binding.
primary_sources.finding: The CIB2 affinity-purification experiment identifies PARD3B association, with gene-level protein inference and assay-specific construct limits.

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected full holdup and protein-production Methods, Results and Discussion read; exact positive target records resolve the CIB2 178–187 peptide and partner PDZ fragments. General validation does not establish that each target pair received orthogonal validation.
primary_sources.finding: The canonical CIB2 tail binds multiple PDZ fragments in direct affinity assays; the results do not establish all native full-length or alternative-product interactions.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Actual full mouse Cib2 BC005739 construct, Ca-overlay, integrin-tail assays and tissue-staining Results/Methods read. Binding to alpha7B is distinguished from proposed activation and from alpha7A.
primary_sources.finding: Mouse Cib2 binds calcium and an alpha7B integrin tail and localizes to muscle membrane specializations.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected full Results and Methods read. Human full-length TMC1/CIB2 FRET comparisons are separate from mouse Y2H constructs and mutant-hair-cell physiology; lack of current alone does not prove a specific gating mechanism.
primary_sources.finding: CIB2 associates with TMC1/2 and is necessary for normal hair-cell mechanotransduction, with mutant-specific effects on interaction.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected actual mouse mutation, localization, channel-current, resting-open-probability and adaptation experiments read. Co-IP constructs are mouse; the crystal structure is CIB3, not CIB2. The R186W analysis isolates TMC2-dependent currents.
primary_sources.finding: Cib2 mutations alter channel localization and resting opening; the tested TMC2 adaptation protocols remain unchanged.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected full human recombinant CIB2/TMC1-domain ITC, SEC/light-scattering, structural and purification Methods/Results read. The article disagrees about fusion orientation and has a CIB2 accession typo; neither is propagated. Mg is assigned in the crystal, and calcium-driven channel closure is proposed rather than recorded electrophysiologically.
primary_sources.finding: Purified human CIB2 binds two TMC1 regions, with metal-dependent partner affinity and a resolved domain-complex structure.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Identifier and complete genuine abstract read. Full body was not recovered; only its stated mouse organotypic perturbation and conformational conclusions are used as context, not detailed construct or kinetic evidence.
primary_sources.finding: The abstract reports calcium-dependent TMC1–CIB2 conformational changes and altered mouse MET conductance after CIB2 calcium-site perturbation.
primary_sources.read_type: complete genuine abstract only; failed access is not full text

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected full mouse retinal genetics, human-protein NanoSPD/co-IP, nucleotide-state binding and mTORC1 assay Methods/Results read. GDP/GTP-loaded RHEB meets CIB2-containing lysate; mouse-brain Raptor immunoprecipitates supply the kinase assay. Direct purified GDI/GAP or kinase inhibition is not established.
primary_sources.finding: CIB2 associates with RHEB and Raptor, restrains mTORC1 signaling and supports RPE processing, with secondary photoreceptor consequences.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Exact main full cache selected. Actual human recombinant fragment SEC/NMR and simulation Methods/Results/Discussion read. Conductance is molecular dynamics of AF2 models, not direct human channel-current reconstitution. Mouse and zebrafish functional experiments are separate.
primary_sources.finding: Human CIB2 simultaneously binds TMC1 N-terminal and loop fragments; monomeric solution behavior and modeled channel stabilization are distinguished from cellular self-association.
primary_sources.read_type: selected actual full text; no figure pixels claimed by owner

primary_sources.access_scope: Selected actual vector Methods and rescue Results read. The CIB2 rescue transgene is mouse Cib2; the alternative rescue uses human CIB3. No human-CIB2 treatment or clinical efficacy is asserted.
primary_sources.finding: AAV-mediated mouse Cib2 or human CIB3 expression improves hearing and hair-cell outcomes in Cib2-deficient mice.

Holdup measures biotinylated CIB2 178–187 against His6–MBP PDZ fragments; primary controls and method limitations remain relevant. No native full-length encounter is inferred.

donor_scope: Current PAINT annotations authenticate their PTN source but do not reconstruct historical IBD placement. Mouse Q9Z309 is Cib2; FlyBase FBgn0034558 maps to Q9W2Q5. A current propagated record is not independent experimental evidence merely because it is listed here.

hearing_process.decision: No new process asserted; exact granularity remains a question, not a claim that auxiliary participation is excluded.
hearing_process.performed_role: CIB2 binds TMC proteins and changes channel behavior; participation is more than necessity and does not require autonomous force sensing.
hearing_process.comparator_query: Human TMIE Q8NEW7, LHFPL5 Q8TAF8, TMC1 Q8TDI8 and human/mouse CIB2 O75838/Q9Z309; exact term response contains TMC1 only. Complete 159 annotations for the three human comparators include broader hearing roles for both auxiliaries.
hearing_process.limit: Current limited comparator patterns neither prove a universal convention nor forbid CIB2 annotation. Pore-forming TMC1 differs in role from the closer auxiliary comparators.
